subject: ela
skillName: Tell a story or recount an experience

items.prompt:
Topic: Losing a tooth for the first time.

Weak description: 'I lost a tooth. It was wiggly for a long time and then it came out. My mom was happy.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing specific details about how the tooth came out, when it happened, what it felt like, or what made the moment memorable. A better detail: 'I was eating a carrot at lunch when my tooth finally popped out and landed on my tray, and I screamed so loud the whole cafeteria looked at me.'

steps: The weak description says 'wiggly for a long time' but gives no specific moment when it came out.
It says 'my mom was happy' but not what the student felt.
Missing details: where it happened, what caused it to come out, how the student felt, any memorable moment.
A strong detail picks one specific moment and describes it clearly.
Example: 'I was biting into an apple at dinner when my tooth finally gave way, and I held it up to the light to see the tiny root still attached.'

items.prompt:
Topic: Watching a parade.

Weak description: 'We watched a parade. It was long and loud. There were many things to see.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing any specific element from the parade, such as what floats, performers, or characters were there, or what happened during it. A better detail: 'A marching band walked by playing drums so loudly my little sister covered her ears and started to cry, even though she was smiling.'

steps: The weak description says 'many things to see' — this could describe any parade anywhere.
It says 'long and loud' but gives no specific example of what was long or what was loud.
Missing details: specific floats, performers, sounds, or a memorable moment.
A strong added detail describes one specific thing that happened.
Example: 'Someone on a float threw beads and they landed right on my head like a crown.'

items.prompt:
Topic: A difficult homework assignment.

Weak description: 'I had a hard assignment once. I worked on it for a while. I finally figured it out.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what the assignment was, what made it difficult, how long it took, or what the moment of figuring it out felt like. A better detail: 'I stared at the same math problem for twenty minutes until I drew a picture of it with dots, and suddenly I saw the answer.'

steps: The weak description says 'hard assignment' but does not say what subject or type.
'Worked on it for a while' gives no information about how long or what strategies were used.
'Finally figured it out' gives no detail about the moment of understanding.
Missing details: the subject, what the problem was, how long it took, what helped.
Example: 'I erased and rewrote the same paragraph five times before my teacher's suggestion to start with a question actually worked.'

items.prompt:
Topic: A surprise.

Weak description: 'I got a surprise once. I did not expect it. It made me happy.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what the surprise was, who gave it, where or when it happened, or what the student's immediate reaction looked like. A better detail: 'When I opened my backpack at school and found a note from my dad that said \"You've got this\" on the day of my spelling test, I read it three times.'

steps: The weak description says 'a surprise' without ever saying what it was.
'Did not expect it' and 'made me happy' are true of all surprises — they add no information.
Missing details: what the surprise was, who was involved, where it happened, the specific reaction.
A good added detail captures the surprise itself or the moment of discovering it.
Example: 'When the lights came on and everyone yelled \"surprise!\" my legs turned to jelly and I had to sit down.'

items.prompt:
Topic: A time you helped someone.

Weak description: 'I helped a friend once. She needed help and I helped her. She was thankful.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing who the friend is, what kind of help was needed, and what actually happened. A better detail: 'When Kezia dropped all her books in the hallway and people kept stepping over them, I stopped and helped her restack them even though I was almost late to class.'

steps: The weak description says 'she needed help' but never says what kind of help.
'I helped her' repeats the topic without describing any action.
'She was thankful' is expected — it adds nothing specific.
Missing details: who, what the need was, what the student actually did, the outcome.
A strong detail shows the action, not just the intention.

items.prompt:
Topic: A moment when you were proud of yourself.

Weak description: 'I did something good at school. I worked hard and it paid off. I felt proud.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what the student actually did, what the hard work looked like, and what specific moment felt proud. A better detail: 'After practicing my oral report on penguins six times in my bedroom mirror, I stood up in front of the class and spoke for two whole minutes without looking at my notes once.'

steps: The weak description says 'something good' — the listener has no idea what it was.
'Worked hard and it paid off' is a general statement with no specifics.
Missing details: what was accomplished, what the work involved, what the proud moment looked like.
A strong added detail shows the action and the achievement.
Example: 'When I finally hit the high note in the choir audition after missing it three times in practice, I looked at my teacher and she gave me a thumbs up.'

items.prompt:
Topic: Trying a new food for the first time.

Weak description: 'I tried something new to eat. It tasted different. I ended up liking it.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what the food was, where the student was, what it tasted or smelled like, or the moment of trying it. A better detail: 'At my friend Yuki's house I tried a piece of dried mango for the first time, and the chewy sweetness surprised me so much I immediately reached for another one.'

steps: The weak description says 'something new to eat' — no name, no description.
'Tasted different' could describe anything from blue cheese to candy.
'Ended up liking it' gives no detail about the moment of changing one's mind.
Missing details: the name of the food, where it was tried, what it tasted like, the specific reaction.
A strong added detail names the food and describes the sensory experience.

items.prompt:
Topic: A funny mistake.

Weak description: 'I made a funny mistake one time. Everyone laughed, including me. It turned out fine.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what the mistake was, where it happened, who was there, and what made it funny. A better detail: 'When I stood up to read my book report, I realized I had been holding the book upside down for the entire presentation, and my teacher very kindly waited until I noticed before telling anyone.'

steps: The weak description says 'a funny mistake' without describing the mistake at all.
'Everyone laughed' tells the reaction without showing what caused it.
Missing details: what happened, where, who was there, what the mistake looked like.
A strong added detail shows the mistake, not just the result.
Example: 'I called my teacher \"Mom\" by accident in front of the whole class and then froze like a statue for three seconds.'

items.prompt:
Topic: Meeting someone new.

Weak description: 'I met a new person once. We talked and had things in common. Now we are friends.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing who this person is, where they met, what they talked about, or the specific moment they connected. A better detail: 'I met Priya at my cousin's birthday party when we both reached for the last red cupcake at the exact same second and started laughing too hard to eat it.'

steps: The weak description says 'a new person' with no name or description.
'Had things in common' gives no detail about what those things were.
Missing details: where they met, who the person is, the specific conversation or moment that sparked the friendship.
A strong added detail shows the exact moment of connection.
Example: 'When I sat next to Diego at lunch and discovered we both had the same dinosaur sticker on our water bottles, we immediately started talking.'

items.prompt:
Topic: A rainy day that turned out to be fun.

Weak description: 'It was raining so we stayed inside. We found things to do and it was actually really fun.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what was done inside, who was there, and what specific moment made the day fun. A better detail: 'My brother and I built a marble run out of cardboard tubes and tape, and by the end we had a track that went from the kitchen counter to the floor, and the marble made it every time.'

steps: The weak description says 'found things to do' with no description of what those things were.
'It was actually really fun' is a conclusion without any evidence.
Missing details: who was there, what activity was done, what specific moment was fun.
A strong added detail shows the activity and what made it work.
Example: 'We pulled out every board game we owned, stacked them in a tower, and ended up just playing Uno for four hours straight.'

items.prompt:
Topic: Seeing something in nature that surprised you.

Weak description: 'I saw something in nature that surprised me. It was not what I expected. I thought it was really cool.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what was seen, where the student was, and why it was surprising. A better detail: 'On our walk home from school, a hummingbird hovered three inches from my face for almost five seconds, and I was so still I could hear its wings humming.'

steps: The weak description says 'something in nature' — the listener has no idea what was seen.
'Not what I expected' gives no detail about what was expected or what was different.
Missing details: what the thing was, where it was seen, what was surprising about it, how the student reacted.
A strong added detail names the thing and describes the surprise clearly.
Example: 'I reached into my garden glove and felt something soft, and when I shook it out, a tiny tree frog landed on my wrist.'

items.prompt:
Topic: A time you were nervous and then felt better.

Weak description: 'I was nervous before something. I felt scared. But then it was okay and I felt better.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what the nervous-making event was, what the nervousness felt like physically, and what happened that made it better. A better detail: 'Right before my class presentation, my voice was shaking when I practiced in the bathroom mirror, but once I said the first sentence out loud in class, the rest came out calm.'

steps: The weak description says 'something' without naming the event.
'Felt scared' is a label, not a description of what nervousness felt like.
'It was okay' gives no detail about what made it okay.
Missing details: the event, physical signs of nervousness, what happened to make it better.
A strong added detail shows the specific moment of transition from scared to okay.

items.prompt:
Topic: A time the weather changed your plans.

Weak description: 'We had plans but the weather changed them. We did something else instead. It worked out.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what the original plan was, what happened to change it, and what was done instead. A better detail: 'We were going to have a cookout, but a thunderstorm moved in, so we dragged everything inside and ate hot dogs from the stove while watching lightning from the window.'

steps: The weak description says 'had plans' with no detail about what they were.
'The weather changed them' gives no description of how or what kind of weather.
'Did something else instead' gives no detail about what that was.
Missing details: the original plan, the weather event, the alternative, any memorable moment.
A strong added detail shows the pivot — what actually happened and how it turned out.

items.prompt:
Topic: Learning something for the first time.

Weak description: 'I learned something new. It was hard at first but I got the hang of it. I practice now.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing what was learned, what was hard about it, and what the moment of getting it right looked like. A better detail: 'The first time I successfully snapped my fingers after weeks of trying, I ran into the kitchen to show my mom and did it seventeen times in a row to prove it was real.'

steps: The weak description says 'something new' without naming it.
'Hard at first but I got the hang of it' describes every learning experience — no specifics.
Missing details: what was learned, what the difficulty felt like, the specific breakthrough moment.
A strong added detail captures the moment it clicked.
Example: 'The first time I landed a cartwheel without falling, I stopped mid-yard and stood very still, wondering if I had imagined it.'

items.prompt:
Topic: Saying goodbye to someone.

Weak description: 'I had to say goodbye to someone. It was sad. But we said we would stay in touch.'

What is missing from this description? Write one sentence that adds a specific, relevant detail that would make it better.
items.answer: The description is missing who the person was, where the goodbye happened, and what the moment of saying goodbye actually looked like. A better detail: 'When my best friend Amara moved away, we stood in her empty bedroom with nothing left on the walls, and instead of crying we took a hundred goofy selfies to save on both our phones.'

steps: The weak description says 'someone' without naming or describing the person.
'It was sad' gives the emotion without showing it.
'Said we would stay in touch' is generic — every farewell includes this.
Missing details: who the person was, where the goodbye took place, what happened in the moment.
A strong added detail shows a specific memory or action from the goodbye itself.
